email_lines._how: Each line is checked for yesterday and for the last 7 days; the section takes the worst. Rates use GHL's own Email Analytics base: per email sent.

brands._how: Product name -> brand. First match wins (case-insensitive 'starts with'). Unknown products show as 'Other'.
brands._confirm: [CONFIRM] Wigs (nbr.education/wigs checkout) are counted as ISLA.

access_checks._how: For every paid order in the last 7 days (amount > 0) whose product matches 'products', the buyer counts as MATCHED when the access workflow left its mark within 'within_hours' of paying: one of 'proof_subjects' was sent to them (any status, even failed: the workflow still ran), or, for workflows that send nothing, the buyer carries one of 'proof_tags'. Counts only are published.

money_lines._how: Section status: green = at least one paid sale in the last 7 days; amber = none in 7 days; red = none in 30 days.

next_sends._how: Flags: (1) a gap of more than gap_days_amber days with no scheduled send inside the window (from now to the end of the window); (2) any single send over big_send_contacts while the email section is amber or red. Audience size: GHL fixes the list when a send starts, so a scheduled send has no count yet; audience_hints gives the last real list size of the same series.

report_rules._how: The daily report is built from these fixed rules, top to bottom; the first one that applies is used for each line.
headline: email red -> 'Email is not healthy: <worst line>.'
email amber -> 'Email needs watching: <worst line>.'
otherwise -> '<sales 7d> sales in 7 days ($<revenue 7d>); email is healthy.'
win: a paid sale yesterday -> '<n> sale(s) yesterday, $<revenue>.'
every buyer in the last 7 days matched -> 'All <n> buyers in the last 7 days got their access automation.'
watch: GHL sending blocked or limited -> 'GHL sending is <state>: <notice>.'
a send over the size limit while email is amber/red -> '<name> (<date>) goes to about <n> contacts while email is <status>.'
an unmatched buyer -> '<n> buyer(s) with no access automation: open in GHL.'
a gap with no sends -> 'No sends scheduled for <n> days (<from> to <to>).'

shopify._how: Later: set enabled true, store_domain, and add the repo secret SHOPIFY_TOKEN (a read-only Admin API token with read_orders only). pull.py then adds ISLA store sales.

postmaster._how: Later: Gmail domain reputation from Google Postmaster Tools. GHL shows it under Email Services > Postmaster Tools (UI-only today).
